generate_speech_text: generate speech or text output from a Spiritlm model given interleaved speech and text inputs
build_prompt_from_inputs: build a prompt string from a list of GenerationInput objects with specified output modality
create_generation_input: create a GenerationInput dataclass instance with content and ContentType for speech or text
decode_generated_output: decode generated token output into speech audio or text based on the specified output modality
parse_speech_and_text: parse generated content string into alternating speech and text chunks with modality labels
